reasoning: On the season so far the Hornets are the stronger team; with home court the Nets start about 1 points better, in a game of about 214 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Hornets.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Hornets win 55 times in 100, by about 2; most games like this end between 188 and 236 total points.
